title: MyoCodec: A Streaming Neural Codec for Electromyography
abstract: arXiv:2609.36687v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural codecs encode continuous signals into compact sequences of discrete tokens, providing an interface for efficient transmission, storage, and token-based sequence modeling. This paradigm has been widely adopted in modern speech and audio frameworks; however, the biosignal domain still lacks a neural codec designed specifically for low-bitrate streaming and generalization across diverse downstream tasks. We present MyoCodec, a streaming neural codec designed for electromyography (EMG). Inspired by recent neural audio codecs, MyoCodec combines causal Transformers with residual vector quantization to encode continuous EMG signals into different levels of EMG representations spanning from continuous latent features to discrete tokens operating at 50 Hz. translated_title: MyoCodec：一种用于肌电图的流式神经编解码器
translated_abstract: 神经编解码器将连续信号编码为紧凑的离散标记序列，为高效传输、存储以及基于标记的序列建模提供了接口。这一范式已在现代语音和音频框架中得到广泛应用；然而，生物信号领域仍然缺乏专门为低码率流式传输以及跨多种下游任务泛化而设计的神经编解码器。我们提出了MyoCodec，一种专为肌电图（EMG）设计的流式神经编解码器。受近期神经音频编解码器的启发，MyoCodec将因果Transformer与残差向量量化相结合，将连续的肌电信号编码为不同层级的肌电表示，涵盖从连续潜在特征到以50 Hz运行的离散标记。MyoCodec在十二个公开肌电数据集上进行了训练，在编解码器内在质量以及代表性下游任务（包括打字（emg2qwerty）、手部……（摘要在此处截断））方面均取得了良好表现。
tldr: 该论文提出了MyoCodec，首个专为肌电信号设计的流式神经编解码器，通过结合因果Transformer与残差向量量化，将连续肌电信号编码为从连续潜在特征到50 Hz离散标记的多层级表示，在编解码质量和打字等多项下游任务中表现优异。
en_tdlr: This paper presents MyoCodec, the first streaming neural codec designed specifically for electromyography, which combines causal Transformers with residual vector quantization to encode continuous EMG signals into multi-level representations from continuous latent features to discrete tokens at 50 Hz, achieving strong performance in both codec quality and downstream tasks.
